annotations.title: One tokenized stock, every network it is on

description: One tokenized stock by its contract address (EVM) or mint (Solana): the issuer, the network, supply (read on chain except Coinbase’s), the issuer’s reference value with its source and time, what is in issue in dollars, who controls the token where read (pause state, transfer policies, supply cap, roles), where it trades and at what premium to the reference (DexScreener, named), what is not yet read, and `sameCompany`: the same company on every other network and issuer we read, with the total. Free. A reference value is not a tradable price; a token with no pool is not traded where we look, never zero liquidity.

address.description: The token contract (0x…) or Solana mint.

name: stock_check

address.description: Its contract (EVM, lowercase) or Solana mint.

chain.description: The network the token is on (base, robinhood, solana, ethereum, arbitrum, bnb, …).

control.description: Read from the token: pause state, transfer policies, supply cap, roles. Null where not yet read for this issuer.

isin.description: The company’s ISIN; null where no issuer we read publishes one for it.

issuer.description: coinbase, robinhood, xstocks, ondo or dinari.

market.description: Pools, price, liquidity and the premium to the reference, as DexScreener aggregates them, with times.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

referenceValue.description: {usd, asOf, source, means}; null where the issuer publishes none.

sameCompany.description: `tokens` on every network and issuer, `networks`, `valueUsd` summed, `valueComplete`.

supplyFrom.description: Where the supply comes from: on chain, or the issuer’s API.

symbol.description: The token’s symbol as its issuer lists it.

totalSupply.description: Tokens in issue on this network; null where it could not be read, not zero.

valueUsd.description: Supply times the reference value on this network; null without both.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
